title: KnowledgeEdge
description: A directed relation between two knowledge nodes. Prerequisite edges form the unlock DAG.

from.description: Source node id. For type=prerequisite, this node must be lit before `to` unlocks (hard rule) or is recommended (soft rule).

type.description: prerequisite = unlock order; related = sibling topic; easily_confused = common mix-up; application = word-problem / use of the skill.

note.description: Optional Chinese hint for authors or UI tooltips.
